messages:
marta: quick note: support reported a tenant accidentally unmasked bulk embeddings and blew past quotas. We should add a preflight + per-tenant inspect credit system to prevent accidental persistence.

owen: agree. minimal design: preflight `/inspect/preview` returns {allowed, estimate, opt_in_needed}. Console must call preview before issuing unmask.

marta: also require redaction-pass before any sampling/persisting. No raw text touches long-term store without consent.

lee: propose defaults:
- persist_rate: 0.01
- endpoints_blocklist: ["/v1/embeddings", "/v1/bulk/*"]
- per_tenant_daily_credits: 50
- soft_block: true  # redact and show request flow to request exception

owen: telemetry: `inspect.preview`, `inspect.unmask.granted`, `inspect.unmask.blocked_reason`, `inspect.persisted`. Tag by tenant_hash+route.

marta: security: handles for unmask must be single-use short TTL tokens, store only handle hashes.

dev-bot: checklist added: feature-flag `inspect_guardrails`, preview endpoint, redact-first pipeline, persistence sampling, alert on redact-failure.

lee: I'll draft a short RFC and mock the console preview tooltip. marta/owen: can you own redact-first and telemetry hooks?

omment: will post RFC link here when ready.
